title: ResourceUri
description: Stable NEXUS resource URI (v1). Tenant/workspace carried in ActorContext, not in URI. Platform domains allow an optional sub-type segment matching vocabulary uri_segment (e.g. agent/run, skill/binding, workflow/run, workflow/template, tool/connection, tool/record, sandbox/profile, model/provider, model/invocation, integration/connection, integration/connection-request).
